lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a grid-like matrix posterior to the pectoral fin. These centroids are organized into approximately four horizontal rows that follow the longitudinal axis of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae; high-intensity blobs are positioned at these intersection points, forming a regular nodal pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadows on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The first dorsal fin exhibits a significant posterior notch or truncation. A man-made satellite tracking tag is visible, attached via a tether to the dorsal surface posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an artificial electronic monitoring device tethered to the dorsal midline.
